comments.text: Just watching less than a minute and already seeing a street in Osaka (at 0:46) instead of Tokyo so that does not look promising🙈

replies.author: @AtlasPlanetOfficial
replies.text: @dominicschijf2354 We understand your point! 😄 However, we’d encourage you not to focus too much on individual shots and instead enjoy the documentary as a whole. In documentary filmmaking, when suitable footage of a specific location isn’t available, a visually similar or nearby reference may sometimes be used to maintain the flow of the story. Thanks for watching and for pointing it out! 🙏🇭🇰

replies.author: @AtlasPlanetOfficial
replies.text: Thanks for pointing that out! 🙏 The street shown at 0:46 is actually representative of Tokyo as well. Similar streets and architecture can be found throughout both Tokyo and Osaka, so we understand how the scene might look misleading at first glance. We appreciate you watching closely! 😊
